other.name: Molech
other.description: The idol to whom the law forbids giving seed through the fire (Leviticus 18:21, 20:2-5)

other.name: Chemosh
other.description: "O people of Chemosh" (Numbers 21:29); the god of Moab

other.name: Baal
other.description: A god Israel served when they forsook the Lord (Judges 2:13); "the high places of Baal" (Numbers 22:41)

other.name: Baal-peor
other.description: The god of Peor, to whom Israel joined himself in Shittim (Numbers 25:1-5)

other.name: Baalim
other.description: The Baals: "the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim" (Judges 2:11, 3:7, 8:33, 10:6, 10:10)

other.name: Ashtaroth
other.description: Strange gods Israel served and put away (Judges 2:13, 1 Samuel 7:3-4, 12:10); in their house the Philistines put Saul's armour (1 Samuel 31:10)

other.name: Baal-berith
other.description: Whom Israel made their god after Gideon died (Judges 8:33, 9:4)

other.name: Berith
other.description: Baal-berith: "the house of the god Berith" at Shechem (Judges 9:46)

other.name: Dagon
other.description: The god of the Philistines (Judges 16:23)

other.name: Ashtoreth
other.description: The goddess of the Zidonians, after whom Solomon went (1 Kings 11:5, 11:33)

other.name: Milcom
other.description: "the abomination of the Ammonites", after whom Solomon went (1 Kings 11:5, 11:33)

other.name: Baal-zebub
other.description: The god of Ekron, whom Ahaziah sent to enquire of (2 Kings 1:2-16)

other.name: Rimmon
other.description: The god of Syria, in whose house Naaman's master worshipped (2 Kings 5:18)

other.name: Ashima
other.description: A god the men of Hamath made in the cities of Samaria (2 Kings 17:30)

other.name: Nergal
other.description: A god the men of Cuth made in the cities of Samaria (2 Kings 17:30)

other.name: Succoth-benoth
other.description: A god the men of Babylon made in the cities of Samaria (2 Kings 17:30)

other.name: Adrammelech
other.description: A god of Sepharvaim, to whom the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire (2 Kings 17:31)

other.name: Anammelech
other.description: A god of Sepharvaim, to whom the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire (2 Kings 17:31)

other.name: Nibhaz
other.description: A god the Avites made in the cities of Samaria (2 Kings 17:31)

other.name: Tartak
other.description: A god the Avites made in the cities of Samaria (2 Kings 17:31)

other.name: Nehushtan
other.description: The brasen serpent that Moses had made, to which Israel burned incense; Hezekiah brake it in pieces and called it Nehushtan (2 Kings 18:4)

other.name: Nisroch
other.description: The god of Sennacherib, in whose house he was slain (2 Kings 19:37)

other.name: Tirshatha
other.description: The governor's title: "the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things" (Ezra 2:63); Nehemiah 8:9 names "Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha"

other.name: Lucifer
other.description: "O Lucifer, son of the morning", said in "this proverb against the king of Babylon"; "Is this the man that made the earth to tremble?" (Isaiah 14:4, 14:12, 14:16)

other.name: Bel
other.description: An idol of Babylon: "Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth" (Isaiah 46:1)

other.name: Nebo
other.description: An idol of Babylon: "Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts" (Isaiah 46:1)

other.name: Rab-mag
other.description: A title of a prince of the king of Babylon: "Nergal-sharezer, Rab-mag" (Jeremiah 39:3, 39:13)

other.name: Rab-saris
other.description: A title of princes of the king of Babylon: "Sarsechim, Rab-saris", "Nebushasban, Rab-saris" (Jeremiah 39:3, 39:13)

other.name: Merodach
other.description: An idol of Babylon: "Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces" (Jeremiah 50:2)

other.name: Tammuz
other.description: "There sat women weeping for Tammuz" at the door of the gate of the Lord's house (Ezekiel 8:14)

other.name: Chiun
other.description: "The tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god" (Amos 5:26)

other.name: Malcham
other.description: "them that worship and that swear by the Lord, and that swear by Malcham" (Zephaniah 1:5)

other.name: Beelzebub
other.description: "Beelzebub the prince of the devils" (Matthew 10:25, 12:24-27)

other.name: Cesar
other.description: "Render therefore unto Cesar the things which are Cesar's" (Matthew 22:17-21)

other.name: Remphan
other.description: "The star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them" (Acts 7:43)

other.name: Jupiter
other.description: "They called Barnabas, Jupiter"; "the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city"; "the image which fell down from Jupiter" (Acts 14:12-13, 19:35); "Jupiter Olympius" (2 Maccabees 6:2)

other.name: Mercurius
other.description: "And Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker" (Acts 14:12)

other.name: Diana
other.description: "The temple of the great goddess Diana"; "whom all Asia and the world worshippeth"; "Great is Diana of the Ephesians" (Acts 19:27-28)

other.name: Augustus
other.description: The emperor to whom Paul appealed: "to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus"; "Augustus' band" (Acts 25:21, 25:25, 27:1)

other.name: Castor
other.description: "Whose sign was Castor and Pollux" (Acts 28:11)

other.name: Pollux
other.description: "Whose sign was Castor and Pollux" (Acts 28:11)
